name: heartlessedly
summary: Pre-1.0.0.6 runs (5:02, then 3:57, the former WR, both patched). He says "New rules require one single run as death warps should not work". That rule is not in the written SRC Raid rules, so it may be a Discord or mod decision. He has two long Twitch VODs of route testing from September.

insights.text: Yes. Its patched now unfortunately. New rules require one single run as death warps should not work.

video.title: RS Dragonwilds: Scorned Wilderness Raid Speedrun in 5:02 (Patched)

insights.verification_note: Not in the written SRC Raid rules (updated 2026-10-31), but Nanobit's 8:32 and 7:01 use a "respawn" skip. Clarify in the Discord.

insights.text: well. i'm thinking with current patch strats, it'll take about anywhere from 12-20 minutes. Kuldra doesn't change, but you have to run the whole raid now. No large checkpoint skips, only puzzle skips and such. I haven't finished routing the new run yet, so I can't give an accurate estimate.
